rework_fixes_verified.summary: Explicit PROD_BOOTSTRAP_FIRST_RELEASE=true passes gate old_new_compat when no state/baseline.json exists and candidate port 8002 is live and the verified versioned SQL and live catalog match the Stage migration contract, without requiring a nonexistent old baseline on port 8001; fails closed if state/baseline.json already exists; retains concurrent old+new readiness check for two-release paths.

prod_atomic_switch.sh journals full baseline_release.json closure (including backend_images for operator_bff, runtime_manager, governance, deployment, lifecycle_projector), prev_runtime_config.js, prev_manifest.json, and prev_compose.env; prod_rollback.sh and prod_ops.sh resume_baseline_singletons use baseline_env (never candidate release_env) and verify the restored lifecycle-projector container runs the retained baseline image.

When a first-release bootstrap aborts after partial switch mutations, prod_rollback.sh drains any started singletons (drain_singletons), stops green (stop_green), removes fe/current and active_manifest.json, restores the explicit 503 no-active-release upstream placeholder, reloads Caddy, and exits 4 (no_rollback_target).

prod_atomic_switch.sh retains immutable FE archives/checksums in fe/artifacts/ and manifests in manifests/, renders deployment.json into fe/releases/<id>/, and prod_ops.sh post_identity + post-rollback baseline_health verify public hosted FE /deployment.json (Cache-Control: no-store) and public BFF /bff/version + /bff/readyz alongside local .artifact_sha256 and BFF/singleton Config.Image.

production-release.yml creates /tmp/pantheon-release-<id> over IAP SSH before SCP, installs and invokes deploy/production/bootstrap.sh and prod_ops.sh prepull_images on the control VM before prod_atomic_switch.sh; bootstrap.sh and prod_ops.sh support non-root OS Login (run_priv), validate runtime binaries and secret content, and pre-acquire only @sha256:... digest-pinned images.

prod_preflight.check_staging_evidence now additionally requires dry_run=false and observed_from_live_vm=true, matching the merged ENV-STG-EPHEMERAL-IMPL-001 staging_verify.sh output, so dry_run_validated or unobserved staging evidence cannot admit production.

Compose now uses accepted native ports (BFF 8001, runtime 8080, governance 8082, deployment 8095), the existing projector run command with GIT_SHA and isolated DSNs; bootstrap and atomic switch render only the accepted pantheon.fe.public-runtime-config.v1 fields (configRef, gcpIdentity, truthful optional configSha256); prod_ops verify_runtime_config consumes configRef/schema/identity/sha; production-release.yml maps and forwards PROD_PUBLIC_GCP_IDENTITY_* and preflight requires them. prod_ops schema/old_new_compat gates and prod_preflight no longer require org.pantheon.migration_set_sha256/compatibility_manifest_sha256 image labels (retained accepted BFF ccb9 has none). They bind manifest migration_set_sha256/compatibility_manifest_sha256 and digest-pinned BFF image to live staging_verified evidence (migration_verified, old_app_new_schema_compatible, matching hash), the running candidate container image, and the Stage migration contract (verified versioned SQL set digest plus live information_schema catalog; gates never apply migrations). Phantom schema_migrations readback removed. prod_preflight.py (migration) re-hashes the qualified migration-spec.json + versioned SQL with Stage's recipe (must equal manifest migration_set_sha256, expand-only) and requires the live information_schema catalog (Stage's query) to contain every relation the SQL creates plus the Stage-required relations; prod_ops.sh migrate applies the same verified bytes out of band. Tests use the unmodified Stage manifest builder with the real versioned SQL and a fake catalog; no schema_migrations table exists anywhere. Local only; not hosted drill evidence.

Workflow now renders migration-spec.json + versioned SQL (Stage recipe, proven equal to manifest migration_set_sha256), ships them with scripts/db_migrate.sh to PROD_MIGRATION_DIR and runs prod_ops.sh migrate before the switch: product base-schema initializer (db_migrate.sh --print-sql, creates public.telemetry_events) first, then the qualified expand SQL, then the gate. Catalog check is column/type/default level (telemetry_events ingested_seq/ingested_at etc. plus SQL-declared columns); id-only and wrong-type catalogs are rejected with independent regressions. No manifests/SQL/hashes rewritten. Local controller tests only (no PostgreSQL binary available in this worker); real-PG replay of the reviewer reproducers is left to the reviewer/hosted drill; not hosted evidence.
